main.description: Move existing posts to an explicit position in a feed.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: Returned when service authentication is required and the caller is not authenticated.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Returned when the authenticated caller is not in the admin allowlist.

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.description: Returned when request structure, placement, or move targets are invalid.

errors.name: UnknownFeed
errors.description: Returned when the target feed URI is not registered.

errors.name: RevisionConflict
errors.description: Returned when expectedRevision does not match the current order revision.

errors.name: OrderRankSpaceExhausted
errors.description: Returned when no rank can be generated within the maximum rank length.

errors.name: OrderConflict
errors.description: Returned when a rank conflict remains after retrying.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: Returned when posts cannot be moved.
